description.zh: 模型编码筛选，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The model code used for filtering. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 模型模板 ID 筛选。
description.en: The model template IDs used for filtering.
The ID of the associated model group.

description.zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Values 0 and 1 return the same result.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 所属模型服务商模板 ID。
description.en: The ID of the model provider template.

descriptions.zh:
您可以分页查询无影 Agent 管理中心中模型服务商模板下的模型模板列表，支持按模型分组 ID、模型服务商模板 ID、模型模板 ID 及模型编码等条件筛选。通过模型分组维度查询时，默认模型将自动置顶。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解无影 Agent 管理中心的操作与使用。
descriptions.en:
You can use paging to retrieve the list of model templates under a model provider template in the Wuying Agent Management Center. You can filter results by model group ID, model provider template ID, model template ID, and model encoding. When you query by model group dimension, the default model is automatically pinned to the top.

Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the operations and usage of the Wuying Agent Management Center.
